name.en: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)

authority: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India

description.en: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) is a government-backed life insurance scheme providing a renewable one-year term life cover of Rs. 2 lakh at a premium of Rs. 436 per year. The scheme is available to savings bank account holders aged 18-50 years. The premium is auto-debited from the linked bank account annually.

verifiedConditions.claim: The subscriber must be between 18 and 50 years of age at the time of enrollment. The life cover continues until age 55 (subject to annual renewal and premium payment), even though new enrollment is not allowed after 50.
The subscriber must have a savings bank account with auto-debit consent. The annual premium of Rs. 436 is auto-debited from the linked account.

unverifiedEligibility: A person can join PMJJBY through one savings bank account only.
Aadhaar must be the primary KYC for the linked bank account.
No medical examination is required at the time of enrollment.
The scheme covers death due to any cause (not limited to accidents unlike PMSBY).
Persons who exit the scheme can re-join subject to payment of premium and a self-declaration of good health.

requirements.claim: Consent-cum-declaration form available at the bank branch or downloadable from the Jan Suraksha portal. The form includes a self-declaration of good health, auto-debit authorization, and nominee details.
Aadhaar number linked to the savings bank account for identity verification and claim processing.
Active savings bank account with sufficient balance (minimum Rs. 436) for premium auto-debit. The account must have auto-debit facility enabled.
Self-declaration of good health as part of the consent form. No separate medical examination is required. However, if the subscriber has a pre-existing terminal illness, the claim may be rejected.

processInformation.claim: Enroll through the bank branch by submitting the consent-cum-declaration form, or through net banking/mobile banking by selecting the PMJJBY option. Some banks support SMS-based enrollment.
The annual premium of Rs. 436 is auto-debited from the linked bank account between 25th May and 1st June each year. The cover period is 1st June to 31st May. If auto-debit fails, the cover lapses.

In case of the subscriber's death, the nominee contacts the bank with the death certificate, the subscriber's Aadhaar, bank passbook, and the PMJJBY claim form. The bank forwards the claim to the insurance company for settlement. The claim amount of Rs. 2 lakh is credited to the nominee's bank account.

output.claim: A renewable one-year term life insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakh. In the event of the subscriber's death due to any cause during the policy period, the sum of Rs. 2 lakh is payable to the nominee. The cover is valid from 1st June to 31st May each year.

fees.applicability: Annual premium for PMJJBY life insurance
fees.claim: The annual premium is Rs. 436 (revised from Rs. 330 in June 2022), auto-debited from the subscriber's bank account. This covers life insurance of Rs. 2 lakh for one year. The premium includes insurance premium, bank administrative charges, and GST.

processingTime.claim: Enrollment is completed on the same day through the bank branch or net banking. Cover begins from 1st June of the enrollment year.

limitations: The scheme provides only term life insurance (death cover); there is no maturity or survival benefit.
New enrollment is not permitted after age 50, though existing subscribers can continue until age 55.
If auto-debit fails and cover lapses, re-enrollment requires a fresh health self-declaration.
Claims may be rejected if the subscriber had a pre-existing terminal illness that was not disclosed.
Only one PMJJBY enrollment per person is permitted across all bank accounts.
The premium was revised from Rs. 330 to Rs. 436 in June 2022; further revisions are possible.
Claim settlement timelines depend on the insurance company and completeness of documentation.
